gloss: to give off a pleasant fragrance; to be redolent

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {薫|かお}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to give off a pleasant fragrance; to be fragrant
definitions.explanation: To emit an agreeable scent or aroma. A more literary and elevated word than {香|かお}る, often used to evoke refined or atmospheric fragrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薫|かお}る⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's the season when the flowers are fragrant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薫|かお}る⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{香|か}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧。
examples.english: The plum blossom fragrance carried on the breeze is pleasant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薫|かお}る⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: A May morning fragrant with fresh greenery is perfect for a walk.

notes:
A godan verb (る row) that is a literary variant of ⟦{香|かお}る→香る：14841_kaoru⟧. While both mean "to be fragrant," {薫|かお}る has a more refined, evocative quality. It is especially associated with classical poetry and seasonal writing.

WRITING:
The kanji {薫|かおる} suggests a warm, enveloping fragrance (related to smoking or incense), while {香|かおる} is the more general character for scent. In modern usage, {薫|かお}る tends to appear in literary or poetic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧{薫|かお}る⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧ — fragrant-breeze May (a classic seasonal expression)
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薫|かお}る — the greenery is fragrant
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薫|かお}る — the flowers are fragrant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香|かお}る→香る：14841_kaoru⟧ — to be fragrant; the standard form, used more broadly in everyday contexts
- ⟦{匂|にお}う→匂う：00319_niou⟧ — to smell; neutral as to whether the scent is pleasant or unpleasant, while {薫|かお}る always implies a pleasant fragrance
